title: Safe access path
statement: For a Boolean mode and a Boolean input $y$, define an access path to be a reflexive transitive sequence of four-work-tape configurations on input $y$ in which each step goes from a safe configuration to the result of one transition of the access program for that mode, using the doubled-input convention.
